package.description: Ultra-lightweight Shift+Space Korean/English IME toggle for Windows

en-US.description: Ultra-lightweight Shift+Space Korean/English IME toggle for Windows
en-US.longDescription:
nShiftSpace (Nexa ShiftSpace) is an ultra-lightweight Windows tray utility
that toggles the Korean/English IME with Shift+Space — the classic Korean
keyboard layout behavior. Single ~5KB executable built with pure Win32 API
and no C runtime; zero CPU while idle, about 0.1MB in Task Manager.
The tray menu has a "Start at login" toggle (HKCU Run value, written only
when you turn it on) and Exit. A keyboard-LED variant is available as a
separate zip on the GitHub Releases page.
en-US.name: nShiftSpace
